verdict: Instagram lead gen is working — 63 leads at $158 each — but phone response and Google Business need attention.
diagnosis: $9,973 spent on Instagram delivered 63 leads at roughly $158 per lead, above HVAC benchmarks but defensible given furnace install ticket sizes.

signals.headline: 63 leads at $158 each
signals.detail: Instagram Instant Form drove 63 leads on $9,973 spend this period. Above HVAC norms but acceptable for install-focused campaigns.

signals.headline: 283 reviews, perfect 5-star average
signals.detail: Reputation is a genuine asset this period. Every new review compounds trust for both Google Business and paid ads.

signals.headline: Only 100 call clicks logged
signals.detail: Google Business generated 100 calls and 172 direction requests. Low relative to 8,374 review views — visibility is not converting.

signals.headline: Click cost climbed to $2.48
signals.detail: Latest period cost per click sits at $2.48 with a $78 thousand-impression cost. Frequency of 1.34 suggests audience fatigue starting.

signals.headline: 353 Instagram followers, 33 engaged
signals.detail: Organic Instagram is quiet. 33 engaged accounts against 6,127 reach means content is seen but not acted on.

benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.subheader: HVAC lead costs vary widely by channel
benchmark.body: Blended HVAC cost per lead on Google Ads averages $104 in 2026, with non-branded search at $149 and Local Services Ads at $72–$95. Your $158 Instagram cost per lead sits at the high end.

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.body: HVAC has the most extreme seasonality in home services, with 40–60% month-to-month demand swings. Late September marks the shift from AC to furnace demand in Illinois.

competitor.label: Competitor
competitor.subheader: Local Services Ads dominate the category
competitor.body: Home services competitors are prioritizing Google Local Services Ads over traditional pay-per-click in 2026. These placements sit above regular search results and charge per qualified contact.

recommendations.title: Test Google Local Services Ads alongside Instagram
recommendations.detail: Local Services Ads run $72–$95 per lead for HVAC and appear above search results. Worth testing to diversify away from Instagram-only lead flow.

recommendations.title: Audit phone response speed on inbound calls
recommendations.detail: 78% of homeowners hire the first contractor to respond. With 100 calls logged this period, confirm every call is answered live during business hours.

recommendations.title: Refresh Instagram creative to counter fatigue
recommendations.detail: Frequency hit 1.34 and click cost rose to $2.48. Consider rotating in furnace-season creative and financing offers to reset audience response.
